We went for a late-night dessert run in Kandivali (located right next to the hospital) and found the place absolutely swamped! At 10:30 PM, there was a visible waitlist, with about a 30-minute expected delay.

Fortunately, we spoke to the manager, explaining we only needed a quick dessert fix. They were very accommodating and quickly arranged a table for us outside!
The service was efficient, and the desserts were definitely worth the effort.

We ordered the Cream of Strawberry, Chocolate Tower, and Sinful Strawberry, and all three were delicious.

If you're in the area and craving a late-night treat, I highly recommend it. Just know that you might encounter a crowd!

featured_reviews.name: Subha Iyer
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhagwati Pav Bhaji is amongst the best and well known for a long time now. This is my second visit after 5 years and I secretly hoped (target I was scared) they had not messed with the taste and the simplicity of a classic pav bhaji!!! Luckily nothing had changed and I was glad to find my favourite pav bhaji in it's straightforward and simple form. So many places dunk their bhaji in tonnes of butter, which doesn't happen here. The right amount of spice, butter. I recommend the classic Pav Bhaji and if you have appetite for more, go for a plate of Kadak Pav, which is crunchy, yummy. I also tried Tawa Pulav, which is not really too spicy and quantity is quite generous.

To complete the meal, we went for a cold coffee, which is one of the best I've ever had, outside home! One doesn't go to Bhagwati for cold coffee, but i would highly recommend this here, for the following reasons : cold coffee definitely needs to taste like coffee, not like dessert, that's reason number 1, here you can actually taste coffee(not just a hint or mild flavour). The sugar levels are just right, not overpowering, it tastes coffee, not coffee shake!!! Third and last reason, there's nothing corrupting this experience in the form of chocolate syrup, chips or ice cubes, it's simply coffee that's mild and cold and right sweet!!! Wow! Didn't expect this surprise at Bhagwati.

If you are in the Western suburbs of Mumbai and are hungry, head here for a nice dinner

Service is quick and unobtrusive. They serve free water along with food, as in all Indian restaurants and eateries.

It's a simple eatery, no frills, with steel table tops and relatively relaxed if one arrives at around 8-830pm on a week day. One can find parking easily on the road after 8pm in that lane.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Rating: ★★★★★

Had an amazing experience at Bhagavati Pav Bhaji in Kandivali West! This place truly lives up to its reputation for serving some of the most flavorful and satisfying street-style food in the city.

Pav Bhaji – The star of the show! The bhaji was rich, buttery, and perfectly spiced with a hint of smokiness. The pav was soft, nicely toasted, and generously buttered. It was served piping hot with chopped onions and lemon on the side – just how it should be. Absolutely delicious and filling!

Pulav Khichadi – Surprisingly, this turned out to be a hidden gem on the menu! It had the comfort of khichadi with the flavors of pulav – mildly spiced, full of veggies, and topped with crunchy farsan and a dollop of ghee. It was both comforting and flavorful, perfect if you want something lighter yet tasty.

The place was clean, service was quick, and the staff was polite. It gets crowded in the evenings, but the wait is totally worth it.

If you’re in Kandivali West and craving good street-style food, Bhagavati Pav Bhaji should definitely be on your list!

featured_reviews.name: The foodie world
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a Pav Bhaji lover, Pav Bhaji Klub Invite is a place you should definitely try. This place is known for serving a wide variety of Pav Bhaji options, and their menu is quite unique compared to regular places. From classic Pav Bhaji to smoked Pav Bhaji, cheese-loaded versions, and even fusion items like Pizza Lasagna, they have something different to offer.

One of the most interesting things about this place is how they experiment with flavors while still keeping the authentic Pav Bhaji taste intact. The smoked Pav Bhaji is a must-try because it has a rich, smoky flavor and tastes amazing with their buttery pav. Their Pizza Lasagna is also very different and perfect for people who like trying fusion dishes.

The ambience is casual and comfortable, making it a good place to hang out with friends and family. The service is quick, and the staff is friendly and helpful with recommendations.

Overall, Pav Bhaji Klub Invite is a great spot for comfort food lovers, especially if you enjoy different varieties of Pav Bhaji. The food is flavorful, the portions are good, and the menu is unique, which makes the place worth visiting.
